# Pull Request Template

## Description
A concise description of the changes introduced by this PR.

## Related Issue(s)
Link to any related issue(s) (e.g., `Fixes #123`).

## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Linting passes (`npm run lint` / `flake8` etc.)
- [ ] Changes follow the project's coding style

## Screenshots (if UI changes)
Include before/after screenshots or GIFs.
